en: Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town, taken from a descending lane with simple houses in the foreground and massive medieval stone fortifications behind. Prominent round defensive towers with crenellations, tall spires and a large Gothic‑style church or castle complex dominate the skyline. There is a water tower with a conical roof further back, and dense town buildings stretching into the distance.
